== 描述 ==
要使用此模板，请添加{{T|{{BASEPAGENAME}}}}模板并填写对应字段。留空的字段不会在文章中显示。本信息框模板使用[[w:Help:Infobox|Fandom的信息框语法]]。

== 语法 ==
<pre>
{{Cast
 | name       = 
 | image      = 
 | caption    = 
 | birthname  = 
 | birthdate  = 
 | birthplace = 
 | deathdate  = 
 | deathplace = 
 | gender     = 
 | height     = 
 | occupation = 
 | appears in = 
 | portrays   = 
}}
</pre>


== 示例输出 ==
{{Cast
 | name       = Test
 | image      = Wiki.png
 | caption    = Test
 | birthname  = Name
 | birthdate  = Date
 | birthplace = Place
 | deathdate  = Date
 | deathplace = Place
 | gender     = Test
 | height     = Test
 | occupation = Test
 | appears in = Test
 | portrays   = Test
}}
